title: Mechanism of antagonist ligand binding to REV-ERBalpha.
one_liner_zh: 该文用GaMD模拟核受体REV-ERBalpha与小分子拮抗剂配体的结合机制，属于蛋白-配体互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法可迁移但对象不匹配。
abstract: REV-ERBalpha, a therapeutically promising nuclear hormone receptor, plays a crucial role in regulating various physiological processes such as the circadian clock, inflammation, and metabolism. However, the availability of chemical probes to investigate the pharmacology of this receptor is limited, with SR8278 being the only identified synthetic antagonist. Moreover, no X-ray crystal structures are currently available that demonstrate the binding of REV-ERBalpha to antagonist ligands. This lack of structural information impedes the development of targeted therapeutics. To address this issue, we employed Gaussian accelerated molecular dynamics (GaMD) simulations to investigate the binding pathway of SR8278 to REV-ERBalpha. For comparison, we also used GaMD to observe the ligand binding process of STL1267, for which an X-ray structure is available. GaMD simulations successfully captured the binding of both ligands to the receptor's orthosteric site and predicted the ligand binding pathway and important amino acid residues involved in the antagonist SR8278 binding. This study highlights the effectiveness of GaMD in investigating protein-ligand interactions, particularly in the context of drug recognition for nuclear hormone receptors.
abstract_zh: REV-ERBalpha，一种具有治疗前景的核激素受体，在调控昼夜节律、炎症和代谢等多种生理过程中发挥着关键作用。然而，用于研究该受体药理学的化学探针有限，SR8278是唯一已鉴定的合成拮抗剂。此外，目前尚无X射线晶体结构展示REV-ERBalpha与拮抗剂配体的结合。这种结构信息的缺乏阻碍了靶向治疗药物的开发。为解决此问题，我们采用高斯加速分子动力学（GaMD）模拟来研究SR8278与REV-ERBalpha的结合路径。为进行比较，我们还使用GaMD观察了STL1267的配体结合过程，该配体已有X射线结构。GaMD模拟成功捕获了两种配体与受体正构位点的结合，并预测了配体结合路径及参与拮抗剂SR8278结合的重要氨基酸残基。本研究凸显了GaMD在研究蛋白质-配体相互作用中的有效性，特别是在核激素受体药物识别方面。
